response.rule_text: No fixed deadline; records must be produced within a reasonable time and the only delay allowed is that needed to retrieve and redact.

fees.labor_rule: A 'special service fee' for extensive clerical or information-technology work.
fees.copy_rule: Actual cost of duplication, or 15 cents per page (plus 5 cents two-sided) where no fee is prescribed.

residency.rule_text: Anyone; the citizenship requirement was removed in 1975.

appeal.body: Voluntary Attorney General mediation (Fla. Stat. 16.60), then mandamus in circuit court
appeal.rule_text: Attorney fees to a prevailing requester.
